posts.author: AlceaAkaza
posts.body:
sorry for being very silent until now...
Hello RPG Maker community!
My name is AlceaAkaza! I am new to this community only joining since VX Ace was given away on Steam for free back in 2024(?). But I just started making my first game with MV (now moved over to MZ) since early last year.
I am still a beginner to using RPG Maker... Well, a beginner to game dev in general since I only moved to RPGM since Unity was too hard for me...
I am currently working on my first game (which is an UTAU fangame), Shinogono Story! A demo is planned to release later this year.
https://twitter.com/i/web/status/1998572527690592470
https://twitter.com/i/web/status/1998827214004220260
https://twitter.com/i/web/status/2007232653360316848
I really can't wait to share my first work with all of you when it releases!
Again, I am very glad to join a community like this!

posts.author: Lionbarrel
posts.body:
Hello and welcome. I absolutely love stuff evolving UTAU/VOCALOID, I don't really involve myself with the fandom per-say, but I've still caught it up And discovering new spooky songs.
Your art looks amazing, and your game looks surprisingly polished for the first attempt!! Crafted with love, I can tell.
Can't wait to see more posts from you.
